modeHelp_fixed: The logo keeps the same size.
modeHelp_shrink: Large on the page, it shrinks as you scroll (visible in “Exact preview”). The bar keeps its height.
alignHelp_center: The logo sits in the middle of the bar's height, whole: it is never cut off.
alignHelp_top: The logo sticks to the top of the bar (apart from the margin), whole.
alignHelp_bottom: The logo sticks to the bottom of the bar (apart from the margin), whole.
alignHelp_grow: The top bar becomes as tall as the logo (with its margins) and the logo sits in the middle of it. The rest of the page moves down accordingly.
fitHelp_contain: The whole logo is visible, with its proportions.
fitHelp_cover: The logo takes the full height of the bar (no margin). A very wide logo is cropped at the sides.
title: Logo
intro: The header signature, or the site name when the theme has none. You can also set it on the page: handle under the logo.
missing: Image not found (removed from the media library)
hintTheme: The logo is the theme's (a drawn signature). Replace it with your image.
hintText: The logo is the site name, written as text. Replace it with your image.
marginsHint: The logo never exceeds the height of the bar minus these margins; for a larger logo, choose “The bar grows”.
mobileHint: “Reduced logo”: size ×0.75 on phones. “Same logo”: the same size as on a large screen, within the limits of the bar.
position: Logo position, from left to right
posHint: The logo stops before the menu and before the edge of the screen. On phones, the offset is reduced. You can also drag it on the page.
backLeft: Put the logo back on the left
